name: Mudaraba
key_source: NOT CODED HERE, AND THIS IS A DETERMINATION RATHER THAN AN OMISSION - the same disposition as ortoq_alloc in loss_mitigation_type.csv. Mudarabah is the HANAFI name for the institution coded in this dataset as 'qirad'. Ramli 2018, 97 on al-Sarakhsi's Kitab al-Mudarabah: al-Sarakhsi treats muqaradah as synonymous with mudarabah, 'the Malikites, Shafi'ites and Hanbalites unanimously use a different term i.e. qirad to denote such an activity', and 'in general, be it mudarabah, or muqaradah or qirad, it is by definition a commercial association whereby an investor or capital provider (rabb al-mal) entrusts some amount of capital to an agent... who trades with it and shares with the investor a pre-determined proportion of the profits'. Coding both rows would enter one institution twice and manufacture agreement between them on every cell. FALSIFICATION CONDITION, so this is not a permanent verdict. The schools are not known to diverge on any of the 32 characteristics, but one candidate is live and unverified: the vault note [[The mudaraba is revocable not locked in]] records that classical fiqh predominantly classifies the contract as an 'aqd ja'iz (revocable) while 'Maliki jurists restrict revocation once the agent has commenced work', flagged there as needing verification against fiqh sources. If that holds, mudarabah (Hanafi) and qirad (Maliki) separate on TS3 revocability - a WP2 capital-lock-in question, not a trivial one - and mudaraba earns a row. Note that qirad's own TS3 is currently uncoded, so the test cannot be run from what is in the matrix; it needs a Maliki source, which the library does not hold. Coded 2026-08-18; see logbook 2 and logbook 4 for that date. SUPERSEDED 2026-10-14: THE DETERMINATION ABOVE ('NOT CODED HERE ...') IS REVERSED. REOPENED AND CODED 2026-10-14, open, claude-opus-5-5 (pass mudaraba-qirad-2026-10-14; brief records/NOTES-mudaraba-sarakhsi-2026-10-14.md; rulings and every cell's evidence in records/RULINGS-mudaraba-qirad-2026-10-14.md). GROUNDS (ruling 1): (i) its premise, that the schools are not known to diverge on any characteristic, failed on CI5 (rulings 1-3 of records/RULINGS-latin-hanafi-mixing-tests-2026-10-13.md: unconsented mixing is a liability event in Hanafi law and lawful in Maliki law); (ii) its falsification condition, TS3, can now be run on Maliki texts; (iii) a single Islamic row would fail the split test; (iv) carrying Hanafi evidence in the Maliki qirad row is the hygiene error refused at ruling 3 of 2026-10-07. The objection that one institution is entered twice is answered by treating mudaraba and qirad as ONE ISLAMIC DATUM in any comparative claim, as Genoa, Pisa and Catalonia are one Latin datum. SOURCE: al-Sarakhsi, al-Mabsut, vol. 22, Kitab al-mudaraba, 17-188 (Dar al-Ma'rifa printing, via the Arabic Wikisource transcription, revisions 281306 and 281305), searched by term counts and read at the passages cited in each cell; Ramli 2018 is a reading of the same text (one witness) and carries no cell. RESULT: 33 cells. The rows separate on TS3 (1 against P) and CI2 (0 against 1) - the pre-named test, on the investor's power to force liquidation (al-Sarakhsi 22, 72; Mudawwana 3, 662-663; Muw 2052), not on revocability after commencement, since both schools void the investor's recall once goods are bought - on TS1 (0 against P), and on CI5 (segregated against commingled; the motivating datum, carrying no weight). They agree on the other 29. A CONTRAST NO COLUMN HOLDS: the Hanafi investor is exposed beyond his capital for purchases within the mandate (22, 76, 172-175) and the Maliki investor is not (Mudawwana 3, 641; Muw 2055); AP3 and LR1 are located on the labour party, so it is recorded in both rows' AP3 notes. NON-INDEPENDENCE (declared before the rows): one text per school; the schools share the contract's early reports and an asserted consensus, so their agreement on the contract core is one witness, parallelism at most, never corroboration; the commenda family's Latin rows are one datum and its Islamic rows another. SELECTION: the row was opened after test 2 of the mixing tests, because the schools were seen to differ; CI5 carries no weight as a result. LATIN LINKS (ruling 5): none declared from this row; whether commenda's link should name both Islamic rows, one or neither is MS's call. Period narrowed to the texts' span (ruling 3).

name: Qirad
key_source: vault: qirad notes. Ramli 2018, 95-98 and 105 (al-Sarakhsi, al-Mabsut 22) for the Hanafi statement of the same institution. NAME: qirad is the Maliki, Shafi'i and Hanbali term and mudarabah the Hanafi one for one institution (Ramli 2018, 97); the mudaraba type row is deliberately left uncoded on that ground - see its key_source. Loss-allocation aspect coded separately as qirad_alloc in loss_mitigation_forms, where it is identical to commenda_alloc in every cell. NOT HELD WITH TEXT and wanted: Udovitch 1970 (Zotero RPV4XSBG is a linked-URL stub). ENTITY QUESTIONS ASKED 2026-08-30 AND THE ROW STAYS THIN, WHICH IS THE RIGHT RESULT: of the ten, one closes (LP2=0, low - Ramli 95 on muqaradah, the sahib al-mal 'sets aside a certain portion of HIS capital', and 101, the mudarib 'deemed as a trustee, just like a depositor (al-muwaddi)'), AP4 is .NA on the no-founder disposition, and the other eight are .NR. LP2 RESTS ON THE SAME SENTENCE AS loss_mitigation_forms qirad_alloc RB3=none - one piece of evidence in two datasets, not two confirmations. CITATION CORRECTION 2026-08-30: the amana/wakil/daminan passage is on PRINTED PAGE 101, NOT 105. TAFHIM 11 (2018) runs printed 79-111 in a 33-page PDF, so printed = PDF + 78; printed 105 (PDF 27) is the Conclusion and contains none of it. The quoted text is verbatim correct. AP3 and LR1 on this row, and qirad_alloc RB3 in the other dataset, all cite 105 and should be corrected. NOT CONSULTED AND SHOULD BE: the vault note quoted at TS2, 'The mudaraba is revocable not locked in', would close CI2 (to 0) and bear on AP2; only HistorEE_codebooks was granted for that pass, so ~/GitHub/myfoamrepo was not read. CI5 CODED 2026-10-12 (pass commenda-italian-recode-2026-10-12): segregated, medium - al-Sarakhsi, al-Mabsut 22, 48 (Dar al-Ma'rifa printing): mixing the capital with his own property without 'i'mal fihi bi-ra'yika' makes the mudarib liable and voids the mudaraba for that sum. CI1 stays .NR: no count of investors is held. MG2 CODED 2026-10-12: single-principal, medium, articulated (al-Sarakhsi, al-Mabsut 22, 41 and 48). CI5 RECODED 2026-10-13 (pass latin-hanafi-mixing-tests-2026-10-13, ruling 3; OF-R0224): commingled, medium, on Sahnun, al-Mudawwana 3, 641 and 645 - the Maliki agent may mix his own money with the qirad unstipulated and without liability; the Hanafi rule (al-Sarakhsi, al-Mabsut 22, 48), which the 2026-10-12 coding carried into this Maliki row, is kept in the cell as the contrast. MG2 still rests on al-Sarakhsi (flagged, not recoded). RE-CODED FROM MALIKI TEXTS 2026-10-14, open, claude-opus-5-5 (pass mudaraba-qirad-2026-10-14; records/RULINGS-mudaraba-qirad-2026-10-14.md). SOURCE: Malik, al-Muwatta', Kitab al-qirad, nos. 2015-2056 (Arabic Wikisource, revision 22122, edition not stated), read in full; Sahnun, al-Mudawwana, Kitab al-qirad, vol. 3, 629-664 (Dar al-Kutub al-'Ilmiyya 1994, via al-Maktaba al-Shamila book 587), searched by term counts and read at the passages cited. Every cell is now Maliki: the twelve cells resting on al-Sarakhsi or Ramli 2018 and the eight resting on Udovitch 1970 / 1962 or [verify] (source_read unknown) were re-pointed or recoded (OF-R0225 to OF-R0244), and ten cells were added (TS1, TS3, TS4, MG1, MG3, MG4, FP1-FP4). The Hanafi evidence now carries mudaraba, coded the same day; the two rows are ONE ISLAMIC DATUM in any comparative claim. They separate on TS3, CI2, TS1 and CI5 - see the mudaraba key_source.
